description: This file defines the class I18NImportErrorDecorator, which provides methods to manipulate I18NImportError objects, including setting language, error, associated string, and employee references, within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: I18NImportErrorDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class providing convenient setter methods for the I18NImportError entity, facilitating association with language strings, languages, errors, and employees.

methods.name: setImportError
methods.description: Sets the I18NImportError object for this decorator.

methods.name: setLangStringById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLangString entity to the import error by its ID.

methods.name: setLanguageById
methods.description: Associates an I18NLanguage entity to the import error by its ID.

methods.name: setErrorByName
methods.description: Associates an I18NError entity to the import error by its name.

methods.name: setImportedEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity to the import error based on employee number.
